'''Grud''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Axial Park]] with many other Mandalorians who fought there. From there he recruited an Imperial hero to complete his contract in eliminating the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] who had been causing problems for the Empire's forces. He also sent another Houk named [[Xev]] to follow the Imperial and make sure he fulfilled the contract as promised.
